name: Adani Power Ltd
tagline: India's largest private thermal power generator, riding the domestic power-demand upcycle with explosive revenue growth from recent capacity/M&A additions, but a commodity-like, coal-linked business trading at a rich valuation with no fresh structural inflection.
business_overview: Adani Power (NSE/BSE: ADANIPOWER) owns and operates thermal (coal-based) power generation capacity across India, accounting for roughly 7.3% of the country's domestic coal-based generation, selling largely under long-term PPAs plus merchant capacity. Revenue has grown extremely fast recently (~118% CAGR per screener, driven by plant acquisitions and capacity additions), well ahead of the power-sector median. Seeded from an untrusted X mention (bullish, medium conviction); this is a mega-cap (~Rs 4.0-4.2 lakh Cr) generic India-power-demand-growth story with no specific new management/regulatory/capital-allocation inflection identified this pass.
fundamentals_narrative: Headline growth and ROE look strong, but both are inflated by recent large capacity acquisitions rather than organic same-plant economics; the business remains coal-price/PPA-linked and commodity-like at its core, with moderate leverage (D/E ~0.82). At ~38x trailing P/E it is priced for continued aggressive expansion, not for a mature regulated utility. No new named CEO/regulatory/capital-allocation inflection surfaced this pass beyond the well-known India power-demand growth narrative.
